People: Parfait-Louis Monteil (author, Wikidata Q3365040), died 1925; Eugène-Melchior Vogüé (introduction, Wikidata Q16053), died 1910; Edouard Riou (illustrator, Wikidata Q583275), died 1900. Printed edition: De Saint-Louis a Tripoli par le Lac Tchad : voyage au travers du Soudan et du Sahara accompli pendant les années 1890-91-92, Paris : F. Alcan, 1895, the Internet Archive scan https://archive.org/details/desaintlouistrip00mont. Three passages of the Gutenberg text have 79%, 94%, 80% of their four-word runs in the scan's text. The scan does not show the credit of Eugène-Melchior Vogüé, whom the catalog lists; the passages show the scan holds this text.
